mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member ( member_id, username, password, name, sex, birthdate, phone, post, addr1, addr2, profile_desc ) VALUES ( mem_mid_seq.nextval, #{username}, #{password}, #{name}, #{sex}, TO_DATE(#{birthdate}, 'YYYYMMDD'), #{phone}, #{post}, #{addr1}, #{addr2}, #{profile_desc} )
INSERT INTO authority (no, member_id, authority) VALUES ( auth_ano_seq.nextval, (SELECT member_id FROM member WHERE username = #{username}), 'ROLE_USER' )
